capability: Decide whether a proposed spend fits its budget: a bounded-autonomy cost governor that returns a within/breach verdict for any additive cost unit (dollars, tokens, API calls, compute-seconds).

Find prohibited vocabulary in any text against a compiled term policy, reporting each offending line:column with a fix - a pure, reusable prose-governance gate (a sibling of a CI-YAML linter, for words not structure).

Classify what changed at a watched source (URL, config, dependency, doc, API) against its last snapshot - first_capture/unchanged/content_changed/broken_link - via an injected fetch seam, returning the new snapshot without persisting it (a source drift detector).

Retry a flaky operation with exponential backoff, for either boundary shape: retry-on-exception (re-raise the final failure) or retry-on-result (return the last result, never raise). One validated policy (attempt budget + backoff) drives both runners.

Fail fast when a dependency is sustainedly broken: a three-state (closed/open/half-open) circuit breaker that trips after consecutive failures, fast-fails while open, then probes once after a reset timeout. Usable as a raw state machine or via a call(fn) runner.

Declare what a process needs from its environment, then load it once into an immutable, type-coerced, validated view. A field marked secret is always redacted; a default requires the explicit dev_default_ok opt-out. Every problem in the environment is reported together, naming the environment variable.
Durably record an opaque operation key exactly once. An atomic claim returns true only to the caller that creates the record, and false to every later caller using the same key.
